subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘STORM’ is written as ‘12694’ and ‘TREND’ is written as ‘29554’. How will ‘WATER’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'STORM’ is written as ‘12694',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba50266de1ff496e9ebf3be27c47360f440a1552329517a27749b44d4b9d19a3.png] 

‘TREND’ is written as ‘29554’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e145bf552bd055a6097cb1dfde6baf3a552e9be17e3bb6e57fa93ff1cfd45d7c.png] 

Similarly, for '**WATER**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0cd29c06829bcc71e4cdc1a818ed7bb526f722a905eddbe782e367ce3e292c8a.png] 

So, 'WATER' will be written as '**51259**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
